messages.completeRequired: Complete required fields and selections before building.
messages.notImplemented: Shape batch build is not yet implemented in this dialog.

batchRecovery.title: Resume Batch Session
batchRecovery.body: Batch session recovery UI is under reconstruction. Please resume or discard sessions via the worker tools until the refactor is complete.

countrySelection.title: Select Countries & Administrative Levels
countrySelection.description: Select countries and their administrative levels to download. Use the matrix to make precise selections.

dataSource.title: Data Source
dataSource.description: Choose a geographic data provider. Each source has different coverage, accuracy, and licensing requirements.
dataSource.licenseRequired: License agreement is required to proceed.

download.title: Download Setting / Cache Management
download.workers: Number of Workers for Concurrent Download
download.workersHelp: Controls how many downloads run in parallel.
download.timeoutHelp: Maximum time to wait for each download before failing.
download.retryAttemptsHelp: Number of retries per failed download request.
download.retryDelayHelp: Wait time between retry attempts when a download fails.

extract1.title: Primary Extraction (Max Zoom Based)
extract1.omissionHelp: When enabled, small features may be removed based on area threshold, minimum vertex count, or hybrid filtering.

extract2.title: Secondary Extraction (Tile Preprocessing)
extract2.omissionHelp: When enabled, extraction/quantization can remove empty geometries.
extract2.extractionModeHelp: Choose how geometry is extracted during tile preprocessing.

filter.title: Extraction Setting
filter.workersStage1Help: Higher concurrency can speed up processing but may exhaust browser memory.
filter.workersStage2: Worker Count for Secondary Extraction (Tile Preprocessing)
filter.workersStage2Help: Higher concurrency can speed up processing but may exhaust browser memory.
filter.methodHelp: Selects how small features are filtered before primary extraction.
filter.minimumAreaHelp: Filters out features smaller than this area during the extract stage.
filter.toleranceHelp: Higher values straighten boundaries and remove fine details. Small or thin features are more likely to be filtered out in combination with the filters. Downstream (secondary extraction and tile generation) becomes lighter and smaller, but geometric fidelity decreases.
filter.toleranceHelpStage2: Applies secondary extraction for tile preprocessing.
filter.minVertexCountHelp: Only apply area filtering when feature vertices exceed this count.
filter.quickRejectHelp: Lower values reject more tiny features quickly.
filter.simpleShapeVertexHelp: Vertex count threshold for simple-shape handling.
filter.elongatedShapeHelp: Correction factor for elongated simple shapes.
filter.quantizeHelp: Coordinate quantization used in tile preprocessing to reduce size and stabilize boundaries.
filter.quantizeStarHelp: ★1 is the coarsest rounding (lowest precision); higher stars increase precision.
filter.enablePerFeatureExtraction: Allow extraction to omit countries or municipalities
filter.enablePerFeatureExtractionHelp: Geometries may be omitted, but metadata is retained.

tile.title: Tile Generation (Zoom-Aware Final Extraction)
tile.descriptionTooltip: Performs final zoom-aware extraction and generates vector tiles.
tile.bufferSizeHelp: Extra margin to avoid visible seams at tile edges.
tile.maxZoomHelp: Highest zoom level to generate tiles for.
tile.zoomRangeHelp: Generate tiles within this zoom range.
tile.zoomSegmentsHelp: Number of zoom ranges to segment.
tile.zoomBreakpointsHelp: Set breakpoints inside the supported zoom range.
tile.expandFactorHelp: Extra tiles to include around each group when building TopoJSON.
tile.expandMarginHelp: Additional margin in tile units for neighbor selection.
tile.tileCountThresholdHelp: Stops tile generation once the tile count exceeds this value.
tile.zoomLevelsHelp: Zoom levels to generate tiles for.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Visualize generated vector tiles on the map.
preview.noTiles: No vector tiles are available yet. Run the build to generate tiles.
preview.waiting: Vector tiles are being prepared. The map will appear once tiles are ready.

metadata.missingSession: No metadata entries have been generated yet.
metadata.empty: No metadata entries have been generated yet.

extract2.title: Extract (Stage 2)
extract2.description: Prepare extracted buffers for tile generation.

vectorTiles.title: Vector Tiles
vectorTiles.description: Generate vector tiles for the selected zoom range.
